skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 90% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 190% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to grant self [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 20% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to grant self [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 30% of own HP).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. After being attacked, has a 100% chance to reduce DMG taken by 10% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. After being attacked, has a 100% chance to reduce DMG taken by 20% for 2 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 25%. After being attacked, has a 100% chance to reduce DMG taken by 25% for 2 turns.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
